name: Detective Club: Gallery of Shadows Collector's Edition
detailed_description:
A forgery that leads to a buried secret.Detective Club is an exciting hidden-object puzzle adventure where you step into the shoes of a young detective, solving mysteries and uncovering secrets that have been hidden for centuries.

When a long-lost Renaissance painting is unveiled at an art gallery, three young detectives uncover more than they bargained for. "The Knight’s Oath" appears to be a masterpiece, but George quickly notices discrepancies that reveal it’s a forgery. With his friends Thomas and Emily, they dive into a thrilling investigation, following a trail of cryptic clues and historical puzzles. But as they dig deeper, they uncover a dark secret hidden within the original painting, one that’s been buried for centuries and could cost them everything.

🔹 Unlock a gripping bonus chapter and unravel a final mystery hidden in your father’s journal!
🔹 Test your detective skills and solve cases adults can’t crack!
🔹 Discover hidden collectibles and extra content as you explore the story’s twists and turns.
🔹 Solve intricate puzzles and play relaxing mini-games to unlock vital story elements and achievements.

Get ready for an adventure full of secrets, danger, and deception!
